description: Feedback2Me Ops V2 — activation matrix. For each not-yet-fully-live component: current -> target observability, the dependency that blocks it, whether the USER must act, whether it can be activated BEFORE a public mobile release, and the exact next step. Principle: public release is NEVER an observability precondition — maximise pre-release coverage.

legend.canActivateBeforePublicRelease: true = achievable with ops-config / staging / native TEST build; false = only meaningful after a real public release

Configure syn-ai-summary on staging: POST a fixed tiny prompt, assert choices[0].message.content parses. Minimal token cost; staging only.

publicReleaseGated.note: No component's HEALTH observability strictly requires a public App Store / Play production release. Everything above is activatable via ops-config, staging, or a native TEST build. Only production-user-SCALE product analytics (conversion, retention) is inherently post-release — that is product analytics, out of ops-health scope.
